entities.name: Ludvík Vébr
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ludvík Vébr is a Czech rower who competed for Czechoslovakia in the 1972 Summer Olympics and in the 1976 Summer Olympics. Ludvík Vébr is also associate professor (docent) at Czech Technical University in Prague. He is expert in the road engineering.
